// 02 · THE ARENA
Stake to payout in six steps
01
CREATE
Open a room in AT or BNB, from $3 or 10 AT.
02
READY CHECK
60-second check: EIP-712 signature or a 50 AT bond.
03
LOCK
Stakes locked in ArenaEscrow or the AT ledger.
04
PLAY
The client captures the screen every 3–5 seconds.
05
VERIFY
Vision engine reads it; both teams must agree.
06
PAYOUT
Winner receives the pot minus 5%, automatically.
EXAMPLE
CS2 1v1 · 500 AT + 500 AT in escrow → winner receives 950 AT · Arena earns 50 AT (5%)

// 03 · THE ENGINE
Five layers guard every payout
L1
SMART-CONTRACT ESCROW
Reentrancy guards, pull-payment fallback, refunds that survive a pause, 24 h oracle timelock, fee capped at 10%.
166 TESTS
L2
CROSS-TEAM CONSENSUS
Pays only when a majority of both teams agree. Contradicting reports are auto-penalised: 24 h, 7 days, then a ban.
BOTH SIDES
L3
VISION ENGINE
Five per-game detectors read the end screen with OpenCV and Tesseract; uploads repeat until confidence reaches 0.8.
OCR + CV
L4
ANTI-CHEAT
Cheat-process blocklist, overlay detection, frozen and replayed frame detection; warn → forfeit → suspend → ban.
SERVER-SIDE
L5
PLATFORM SECURITY
TOTP 2FA, JWT revocation, timing-safe login, 20 rate limits, HSTS + CSP, payout kill-switch, recovery jobs.
7 AUDITS
